_: Storyboard keys this engine supports, for the lint and the agents (read this instead of searching studio/README.md for words). Update it in the same commit as the engine code that adds a key.

keys.cast: storyboard header: the episode's own people, rig traits (channel-system/characters/cast.md)
keys.ots: shot: { speaker, listener } for frame ots
keys.set.mid: a set's own middle layer ({ back, mid, front } in sets.js): figures, living things and extras stand in front of it at any y, e.g. the wire desk
keys.extras: shot or panel: number of background people (up to 14)
keys.opts.dress: a named look of a set (VARIANT or DRESS in sets.js): trading_floor dawn/exchange, corridor exec/doors/courthouse, lawn playground/park, office after_hours/cubicle, back_shop engraver/print, night_office recruiter, pitch_stage earnings, farmers_market night, bank counter (+sign/chart), street shuttered, kitchen jar, train_platform night, stadium scoreboard, bedroom dusk, boardroom head_chair/two_chairs, theatre coat_check/box_office/dressing_room
keys.opts.rain: rain streaks over the picture (bus_stop at night by default, phone_booth always; false turns it off)
keys.opts.empty: a place that stays empty (no extras)
keys.audio.ambience: false turns the place beds off
keys.foley: act sounds, placed by mix.mjs from the acts
keys.audio.foley: false turns the act sounds off
keys.acts.to: a walk (a person walks with legs; a living thing rocks)

defaults.palette: studio/engine/sets.js SET_PALETTE (each set's colour when a shot names none)
defaults.ambience: studio/engine/sets.js SET_AMBIENCE (each set's bed when a shot names none)

mix_json.foley: { count: actions with a sound, sounds }
